0x100C9C10.name: CXiSkeletonActor_PlaceAttachedInRing
0x100C9C10.evidence: Called by CXiSkeletonActor_OnMove. For the up to 8 actors at this+0x770 (each must pass its vtable +0x1E4): from a centre and radius (FUN_10087770/790/7B0/7F0), sets each one's position at radius * (sin, cos) of angles 15 degrees apart (start from fpatan of the direction to the camera's +0x44), copies rotation and state (5 x 0x68 bytes from this), and sends event 'efon' / 'efof' (vtable +0x298) when the distance crosses the threshold.
0x100C9C10.summary: Places the actor's attached actors on a circle around a centre, 15 degrees apart, and keeps their state and on/off events in step.
